engaged_fit.definition: own-server P - P_idle = f a + (1 - f) b; engaged_W = max(b, 0); overhead_J (Supermicro) and coord_J (frodo) per remote option

HS10.text: R1: model_E's measured pass energy is lower than model_T's if called (predicted ratio >= 1.05) (v0.8 HS4, repeated)

HS5.text: in each regime, the corrected model policy's measured pass energy is at most 1.05 x the corrected oracle's (R1 model_E vs oracle, R2 model_M vs oracle_M, R3 model_E_f vs oracle_f; median over 5 repeats of the per-repeat ratio)

HS6.text: R1: model_E's measured pass energy is at most 1.02 x alone_gpu's (medians of 5 repeats)

HS7.deadline_rule: 1.02 x the midpoint of the shortest predicted pass and the lesser of model_E's pass and the V100 alone's measured pass
HS7.text: R2: model_M meets the deadline (pass time <= D) in at least 4 of 5 repeats, and its measured pass energy is lower than model_T's if that comparison is called (predicted ratio >= 1.05)

HS8.text: R3: model_E_f's measured pass energy is at least 5% lower than each of alone_card_f's and alone_fcpu_f's

HS9.text: every planned policy (R1-R3, 11 policies) has measured/predicted pass energy and pass time within 0.90-1.10 (medians of 5)

R2.rule: 1.02 x the midpoint of the shortest predicted pass and the lesser of model_E's pass and the V100 alone's measured pass
